name: invented-technology
description: Prices and services are right, but the proposal commits the agency to platforms nobody mentioned (Shopify, Stripe, Afterpay, Klaviyo), changes the payment terms to 30/70 and offers a free trial the knowledge forbids. Only the reviewer can catch these.
brief: Gina's Bakery, artisan bakery in Bondi. Site: https://ginas-bakery.example/. They take orders through Instagram DMs and want online orders.

proposal.title: Gina's Bakery: online orders without the Instagram inbox
proposal.summary: Today every order arrives as an Instagram message or a phone call. We propose online ordering built on Shopify, with Stripe and Afterpay at the checkout, plus a Google Business Profile so people in Bondi find you on Maps.
proposal.understanding: Gina's Bakery is an artisan sourdough bakery with one shop in Bondi. Orders are taken by hand through Instagram messages and calls. There is no online ordering and no Google Business Profile.
objectives: Take orders online, without a person answering messages
Appear on Google Maps and in local searches

scope.name: Online ordering
scope.description: A Shopify store with your menu, a cart and a checkout through Stripe and Afterpay, so customers order and pay without messaging you. Klaviyo sends the order confirmations and a weekly specials email.
deliverables: Klaviyo email flows: confirmation and weekly specials

scope.name: Google Business Profile
scope.description: The listing that puts the bakery on Google Maps: hours, photos, categories and a link to order online.

scope.name: Monthly care
scope.description: Hosting, updates, backups and small changes. The first month is a free trial.

timeline.work: Menu, photos and domain access; Shopify and Stripe accounts
timeline.needs_from_client: Menu with prices, photos, access to the domain

timeline.work: Store, checkout, email flows; Google listing
timeline.needs_from_client: Review the preview; verify the Google listing

timeline.work: Go live, train you on the orders screen

investment.payment_terms: 30% deposit to start, 70% on launch. Two rounds of changes included.
investment.ongoing: Shopify from AUD 56 per month and Klaviyo from AUD 30 per month, paid by you. Monthly care optional after the free month.

next_steps: Confirm the scope and the pickup options
Kickoff call to collect the menu and the photos

alerts: Instagram, reviews and the competitor were not verified
questions_for_client: How many orders do you take per week today?

findings.note: Neither the knowledge, the research nor the brief names any platform or payment provider.
The knowledge says 50% to start, 50% on delivery.
The knowledge says no free trials.
